rules.title: Rule sets
rules.description: Rule sets define which releases are acceptable, with requirements for resolution, codec, size, freeleech and preference order.
rules.emptyHint: Click “New rule set” to create one.
rules.help: When several rule sets apply, the one with more conditions wins. Otherwise, the default is used. Changes affect future evaluations; downloaded content is unchanged.
rules.defaultProtected: The default rule set cannot be deleted
rules.scopeTooltip: Automatically selected when a new subscription matches these conditions
rules.fallbackScope: Used when no other rule set applies
rules.unrestricted: No restrictions: accept any release identified as this title
rules.sizeInvalid: Minimum size cannot exceed maximum size
rules.sourceInvalid: The upgrade target must be an allowed source
rules.resolutionInvalid: The upgrade target must be an allowed resolution
rules.unsetScope: Not set (select manually or use as the default)
rules.editorHint: Leave a condition empty for no restriction. All conditions must match.
rules.name: Name
rules.scopeHint: This rule set is selected automatically for matching titles. More conditions take priority; otherwise the default is used. Select only Movie or Series to make this the default for that type.
rules.resolutionHint: Select in preference order, or leave empty for any resolution. Releases with an unrecognized resolution will be excluded when restricted; you can still pick them manually.
rules.sourceHint: Select in preference order, or leave empty for any source. Rips include WEBRip/BDRip; TV recordings include HDTV/DVD. Restricted sources exclude unrecognized releases; you can still pick them manually.
rules.codecHint: Select codec families, including equivalent names such as x265 / HEVC. Leave empty for any codec.
rules.platformHint: Tap to require, tap again to exclude, and a third time to clear. Requiring platforms also excludes releases with an unrecognized platform, as with resolution and codec restrictions.
rules.hdrHint: Tap to require, tap again to exclude, and a third time to clear. “SDR” means no HDR format is declared. “DV P5” is Dolby Vision without an HDR10 fallback layer (colors shift when transcoded); it can only be excluded, so one tap excludes it. Leave empty for no restriction.
rules.groupsAllowHint: Accept only these release groups, separated by commas or spaces (e.g. FRDS, WiKi). Leave empty for any group.
rules.groupsBlockHint: Reject all releases from these groups
rules.subtitleHint: Any selected language may match the torrent title. Releases without a subtitle declaration are excluded. Leave empty for no restriction.
rules.audioHint: Any selected language may match the torrent title. Releases without an audio language declaration are excluded. Leave empty for no restriction.
rules.freeHint: Unknown promotion status is treated as non-freeleech
rules.hrHint: Skip releases with hit-and-run seeding requirements
rules.hrStrictHint: Exclude releases conservatively when the site provides no H&R information
rules.sizeHint: Size is evaluated per episode: season packs use total size ÷ episode count, so the per-episode limit does not reject a whole season pack.
rules.upgradeHint: Keep looking for better releases after completion until the target is reached. After import, old versions stay in the recycle bin for 7 days; seeding tasks are unaffected. Disable to stop after downloading.
rules.cutoffHint: Defaults to your first preferred resolution above
rules.cutoffUnrestricted: Without a resolution restriction, defaults to 1080p to avoid unexpected 4K storage use
rules.keepOldHint: Keep multiple versions (collector mode). When disabled, old versions stay in the recycle bin for 7 days.
rules.priorityHint: Compare dimensions in order; the first difference decides. Each extra dimension may mean another download. By default, only resolution and source are compared. Unconfigured dimensions are skipped; if all are skipped, Resolution › Source is used.
rules.platformWarning: Many release titles omit the platform. Comparing platform first can prevent upgrades because those releases cannot be ranked. Put platform last.
rules.filterSummary: This rule set filters as follows
rules.noConditions: No conditions: accept all releases identified as this title
rules.belowHint: Before reaching the target, any tier below may arrive first. Each better release triggers another download and replaces the old version:
